As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game\-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!


**About the Role:**



We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Analyst\- Commswho is best in class, with a high IQ and a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with strong prospects for continued growth and increased ownership.



The Marketing Analyst \- Comms, will sit at the intersection of data, CRM strategy, and AI\-driven efficiency. We're looking for an execution\-oriented person who owns their work from end\-to\-end. You'll dive into the details of how our campaigns operate across email, push, SMS, and in\-app channels, spot friction and inefficiency, and design smarter ways forward. You'll spend most of your time inside Braze, Sezzle's primary consumer\-focused CRM and marketing automation platform, building and analyzing campaigns across email, push, SMS, and in\-app channels. You'll dig into performance data to identify what's working, surface gaps in our consumer journeys, and develop new comms to fill them. You'll also look for every opportunity to apply AI tools to make the team's output faster, sharper, and more scalable.  

This isn't a role where you wait for assignments. We want someone who can look at a set of data, identify the opportunity, and start building toward it then communicate what they found and why it matters to the team around them.


**What You'll Do:**


* **CRM Campaign Execution \& Analysis**


	+ Build, launch, and iterate on campaigns and canvases in Braze across email, push, SMS, and in\-app channels.
	+ Audit existing consumer journeys to identify engagement gaps, drop\-off points, and missed messaging opportunities.
	+ Develop segmentation strategies and personalized comms that improve activation, engagement, and retention.
	+ Support A/B test design, execution, and readout — translating results into clear, actionable recommendations.
	+ Maintain performance dashboards and reporting frameworks that make campaign data interpretable for the broader marketing team.
	+ Track KPIs including DAU, ARPDAU, LTV per user, open rates, click rates, and conversion, and surface insights tied to those metrics.
	+ Effectively manage our marketing CRM tool to drive new and innovative use cases that can be shared across the team
	+ Write SQL queries to investigate issues and campaign results using internal data**AI, Automation \& Process Optimization**


	+ Identify opportunities to apply AI tools and automation across marketing workflows from copy generation to campaign QA to performance analysis.
	+ Build and iterate on tools, templates, and agents that reduce manual effort and improve output consistency.
	+ Stay current on emerging AI/automation capabilities and bring concrete recommendations for how they can be applied within Sezzle's marketing stack.**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


	+ Partner with marketing, product, data, and engineering teams to align on tooling decisions and ensure smooth implementation.
	+ Serve as a connector between technical teams and marketing stakeholders, translating requirements in both directions.
	+ Facilitate adoption of new tools and workflows by developing documentation, training materials, and hands\-on support for team members.
	+ Identify and flag integration risks early; bring concrete mitigation recommendations.

**What We Look for:**


* **Skills \& Competencies**


	+ Hands\-on experience building or implementing AI tools, agents, and automation in a professional setting.
	+ Strong analytical skills, comfortable working with data, running queries, and presenting findings with context.
	+ Experience in consumer marketing operations, CRM platforms (Braze or similar), or marketing technology stacks; Braze experience is a plus.
	+ Ability to identify process inefficiencies and develop structured, scalable solutions.
	+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and you can explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical teammates.
	+ Basic project management skills; organized, proactive, and reliable with deadlines.
	+ Experience with segmentation, A/B testing, and performance reporting.
	+ Strong experience in data visualization tools and SQL.
	+ Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously**Educational \& Professional Experience**


	+ Background in computer science, analytics, engineering, AI, and/or related fields.
	+ Exposure to business, marketing, finance, or other related fields
	+ Previous internships or academic projects involving campaign management, marketing analytics, and content creation preferred.
	+ Professional, academic or personal projects that demonstrate an ability to creatively use AI to create efficiencies.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience building AI\-first platforms or internal products from scratch, including early architectural decisions.
* Strong foundation in core machine learning and data science principles, including supervised/unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and statistical inference.
* Experience with transformer architectures (BERT, GPT, etc.) and understanding of attention mechanisms, tokenization, and fine\-tuning strategies for domain\-specific applications.
* Experience developing AI\-assisted or agentic systems that interact with tools, data, or workflows.
* Familiarity with embeddings and vector representations, including text embeddings, similarity search, and integration with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or similar).
* Experience with NLP techniques including text classification, named entity recognition, semantic search, and information extraction.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native development using AWS.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and LLM application patterns.
* Experience with containerized systems and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows (e.g., GitLab).
* Experience with Golang is a plus (or willingness to learn).
* Experience with Braze or similar consumer facing CRM platforms and/or various B2C digital marketing channels like affiliate, CTV, paid social, paid search, GEO/SEO, DSP.

**About You:**


* **You have relentlessly high standards** \- many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
* **You're not bound by convention** \- your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
* **You need action** \- speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk\-taking.
* **You earn trust** \- you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

**What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:**



At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out\-of\-the\-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

The Senior Analyst, Quality Assurance provides independent assurance over compliance operations supporting regulated payment services, including fiat and digital currency payment flows and payment schemes.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

* Demonstrated ability to identify control gaps, perform root cause analysis, and support remediation

* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to learn complex products, payment flows, and regulatory requirements quickly

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

* Familiarity with digital assets, stablecoins, or emerging payment technologies

 **Habilidades técnicas:**

* Modelización financiera avanzada (LBO, DCF, modelos de fusión, modelos de integración). Capacidad de construir y auditar modelos complejos desde cero.

 **Competencias para la ejecución (sin origación)**

* Orientación al detalle y a la calidad del entregable, con cero tolerancia a errores en modelos o documentos legales.
* Capacidad de gestión de proyectos integral: seguimiento de cronogramas, actas de reuniones, listas de acciones pendientes.
* Comunicación efectiva con el cliente (reportes de avance, alertas tempranas de riesgos, traducción de temas técnicos a lenguaje de negocio).

**Idiomas**

* Inglés fluido (C1/C2\) indispensable para negociar contratos y leer documentación internacional.

 **Otros requisitos deseables**

* Disponibilidad para **viajar** esporádicamente a oficinas del cliente o reuniones con asesores.

* We think big

* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Design teams to deliver data\-driven solutions that align with business goals.
* Effectively communicate insights and analysis results to stakeholders across SimplePractice, highlighting opportunities to better serve both the business and its customers.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information to multiple stakeholders.
* Strong project management and organizational skills
* Enthusiastic about data and analytics, learning new techniques and skills, and working with data scientists and engineers.

* Experience with dbt Cloud or similar tools
* Knowledge of ETL pipelines and data warehouse best practices
* Knowledge of techniques such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and multivariate analysis.

Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

  

We are looking for a **Lead Technical Product Manager, API Integrations,** to join our Supply domain, more specifically in the Integrations team, which is responsible for onboarding carriers onto our system (integrating external systems, harmonising data structures and building revenue\-increasing products for carriers). This is key to scaling our business; therefore, our focus is on innovation and automation.

* Be a people leader and help drive and motivate other Technical Product Managers and Integrations Analysts to success
* Extend functionalities to enable new opportunities

title: Payroll Manager
description:
**Mission:** Ensure the financial integrity, accuracy, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency of the end\-to\-end payroll process for both manufacturing plants and corporate personnel. This includes the correct registration, supervision, and control of all payroll transactions, weekly and biweekly closures, special payroll events, SOX compliance, financial reconciliations, and adherence to fiscal and labor regulations applicable in Mexico.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Payroll Operations Management (Manufacturing \& Corporate)
  
  

Lead, supervise, and control weekly (hourly), biweekly (salary), and special payroll processes, including profit sharing, bonuses, savings fund, retroactive adjustments, complementary payrolls, and off\-cycle payments.
  
Validate daily timekeeping and payroll incidents in E‑Time, ensuring timely authorization by plant stakeholders.
  
Monitor overtime processes, ensuring Industrial Engineering approvals are in place prior to execution.
  
Oversee and confirm all weekly and biweekly payroll closures (Hourly \& Salary).
  
Guarantee compliance with operational calendars, union agreements, corporate policies, and legal requirements.
  
Coordinate the issuance, delivery, and stamping of payroll receipts, ensuring accuracy of Stellantis payroll concepts versus SAT requirements.
  
  

Financial Controls, SOX Compliance \& Reconciliations
  
  

Ensure full SOX compliance across all payroll processes and supporting documentation.
  
Approve monthly and quarterly financial reconciliations in OneStream.
  
Oversee accurate accounting of all payroll events, including provisions, settlements, bonuses, and special transactions.
  
Implement preventive and corrective controls to reduce operational risks (e.g., automated validations before closure).
  
Review and approve ART \& MIS reclassification journal entries.
  
Ensure that work orders, authorizations, and supporting documents are complete to prevent cost deviations.
  
  

Banking, Disbursements \& Financial Movements
  
  

Request and manage funding for payroll disbursements.
  
Prepare and validate Banamex and BBVA layouts for payroll payments, meal assistance, and financial transactions.
  
Authorize all payroll\-related payments executed through banking platforms.
  
Oversee bank account changes, card assignments (Pluxxe, meal vouchers), and financial compliance requirements.
  
Supervise INFONAVIT, FONACOT, and fiscal processes required for stamping (CFDI).
  
  

Systems Integration, Data Management \& Technology Coordination
  
  

Lead system changes, enhancements, and new functionality implementations across payroll platforms (Workday, Strada, SAP, E‑Time).
  
Resolve payroll system inconsistencies in collaboration with ICT, tax, and external providers (e.g., PAC).
  
Ensure proper data flows between timekeeping, HRIS, and payroll systems, maintaining data integrity.
  
Manage stamping (CFDI) error resolution and coordinate corrections with Tax and PAC.
  
  

Cross\-Functional \& Plant Coordination
  
  

Supervise and guide payroll analysts across manufacturing plants (Saltillo \& Toluca) and corporate headquarters (Santa Fe).
  
Conduct regular staff meetings to align processes and ensure consistent execution across locations.
  
Maintain strong collaboration with HR, Labor Relations, Finance, Industrial Engineering, and the Legal Department.
  
Ensure timely and validated information from Labor Relations for weekly/biweekly closures.
  
Oversee alimony deductions in alignment with legal requirements and internal policies.
  
  

Continuous Improvement \& Automation
  
  

Drive process improvement initiatives focused on standardization, automation, and operational excellence.
  
Participate in digitization and automation projects to increase payroll accuracy and efficiency.
  
Define and monitor KPIs to track process performance (incident errors, rejections, dispersion failures, etc.).
  
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual interventions.
  
Responsible of New Payroll System launching (if apply)
  
  

Staff Management \& Development
  
  

Train new hires and oversee onboarding and development of payroll analysts and interns in plants and corporate sites.
  
Provide clear operational guidance and ensure compliance with established standards.
  
Evaluate team performance based on objective operational results and adherence to processes (without personal judgments).
  
  

Additional Corporate Responsibilities
  
  

Responsible of payroll accounting reconciliations, audit documentation, reports, and presentations for all management levels.
  
Coordinate actuarial study data preparation and Annual Company Declaration requirements.
  
Review and deliver reports for INEGI, internal auditors, external auditors, and fiscal authorities.
  
Manage payroll obligations related to expatriate assignments (Mexican personnel abroad).
  
Ensure proper execution of Executive Bonus disbursements according to HR and Tax instructions.
  
  

**Education:**  

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.
  
Master degree (preference)
  
  

**Experience:**  

Minimum 10 years in payroll operations, finance, or controllership.
  
Experience managing manufacturing payroll processes (preferred).
  
  

**Technical Knowledge:**  

E‑Time
  
Payroll systems (SAP, Workday, Strada or equivalent)
  
SOX controls
  
CFDI/timbrado processes
  
Microsoft Excel \& PowerPoint
  
OneStream reconciliations
  
Mexican labor \& payroll tax regulations
  
  

**Skills:**  

Leadership and team management
  
Strong cross\-functional communication
  
Critical problem\-solving under time\-sensitive conditions
  
High attention to detail and organizational discipline
  
Ability to work effectively under payroll closure pressure
  
Service\-oriented mindset and stakeholder management

description:
**Senior QA Analyst (Mobile) \- LATAM**

**Mexico or Brazil**

**Role**


We’re seeking a Senior QA Engineer (Mobile) to drive end\-to\-end quality for our mobile applications, embedding quality practices into the engineering team (“shift left”) and ensuring high\-confidence releases in a regulated fintech environment.


This is a hands\-on role with full ownership of mobile testing. You will be responsible for defining and driving the mobile automation strategy across iOS and Android, building the foundations of our mobile automation framework, and establishing scalable, maintainable testing practices from the ground up.


We’re looking for someone who takes true ownership — not just maintaining tests, but shaping the approach, improving coverage and reliability, and continuously raising the quality bar. You should be comfortable leveraging modern AI\-assisted tools responsibly to increase testing efficiency, improve signal quality, and accelerate feedback loops.


This role requires strong collaboration skills — working closely with Mobile Engineers, Backend Engineers, Product, and other QA team members to ensure alignment, knowledge sharing, and consistent quality standards across platforms.

**About Us**


Sokin is a next\-generation B2B financial services provider, enabling businesses to make and receive global payments with greater speed, lower cost, and total transparency. Our mission is simple: we’re simplifying global business \- so businesses thrive wherever they choose to grow. We deliver services across:

* Global payments and receivables
* Foreign Exchange (FX)
* Treasury management
* Finance reconciliations

We are rapidly expanding, with established presence in EMEA, APAC, and North America,


Backed by a strong global infrastructure and industry\-leading partners, we are redefining how businesses move money worldwide.


Our clients span industries from sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, and our community is growing rapidly. As we continue to expand, we’re building a team of exceptional people who share our ambition to transform the future of global payments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Embed quality “shift\-left” practices into the mobile delivery team: clarifying acceptance criteria, defining test strategy, and influencing architecture for testability and observability.
* Own mobile testing end\-to\-end across iOS and Android applications, including functional, regression, exploratory, and automation coverage.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable mobile automation frameworks for iOS and Android, establishing best practices, standards, and maintainability from the ground up.
* Drive automation strategy for mobile platforms, ensuring stable CI/CD integration, reliable execution, clear reporting, and proactive flaky test management.
* Validate critical fintech workflows within mobile applications such as onboarding, authentication, payments, FX conversions, approvals, reconciliations, and role\-based permissions.
* Validate APIs and backend services that support mobile platforms, ensuring correct integrations, authentication/authorization, error handling, and resilience.
* Test non\-functional requirements relevant to regulated mobile platforms: resilience, performance, offline/poor network behavior, monitoring/alerting behavior, auditability, and production readiness.
* Perform and support security\-focused testing activities, including validation of secure storage, session management, authentication flows, device\-level considerations, and awareness of common mobile and web vulnerabilities.
* Collaborate closely with Engineers, Product, Compliance/Risk, and Operations to ensure aligned quality standards and controlled releases.
* Support other team members in automation best practices, promoting knowledge sharing and raising the overall quality culture within the team.
* Apply AI\-assisted testing pragmatically (e.g., generating test scenarios, exploratory support, log analysis, automation refactoring), while managing risks such as hallucinations, data leakage, and over\-reliance.
* Drive continuous improvement via root cause analysis, defect trend insights, and prevention\-focused actions (not just detection).
**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in mobile test automation, with strong ownership of quality outcomes in modern product teams (Senior level expectation).
* Strong hands\-on experience in mobile automation testing for both iOS and Android (required).
* Proven experience designing and building mobile automation frameworks and establishing foundational best practices.
* Experience integrating mobile automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, including reporting, gating, and flaky test triage.
* Strong understanding of testing mobile application architecture, API integrations, and backend dependencies.
* Strong API testing capability (REST/JSON), including negative testing and schema/contract validation.
* Experience working in fintech or regulated financial services environments, understanding compliance, auditability, and release control expectations.
* Experience with security testing of mobile applications, including secure storage, authentication, authorization, and common mobile/web vulnerabilities.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS or equivalent) and mobile test environments (real devices/emulators/simulators).
* Practical use of AI in testing to improve coverage, speed, and effectiveness.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work cross\-functionally and help elevate team practices.
* Strong bonus: experience with web automation using Playwright.
*Please note, candidates will need to have the right to work in the jurisdiction that they are looking to work in.*

title: Sr Quality Insights Analyst
description:
**About the Team**
------------------



The Quality Assurance team drives customer support insights to both our internal \& BPO partner stakeholders, utilizing our quality assurance audit data as well as exciting new technologies in Conversational Intelligence AI. The team's primary role will be to establish mechanisms to ensure our quality audits consistently provide insights that drive process improvements in our support experience.


**About the Role**
------------------



As a **Senior Associate, Calibration Insights Analyst**, you'll be a key architect of calibration excellence across DoorDash Support. You will lead analytical deep dives to identify root causes of quality misalignment, investigate edge cases, and surface systemic opportunities to improve how our GenAI\-powered QA systems operate.



You'll collaborate closely with Model Calibration Specialists, the Performance Excellence team, and stakeholders across CXI to implement projects that improve agent performance, policy alignment, and customer outcomes. You'll help maintain trust in our machine learning model's QA outputs by ensuring our quality signals are precise, fair, and strategically useful.



This role requires comfort working with GPT/LLM\-based systems and the ability to turn raw calibration data into insights that influence our long\-term QA strategy.



You will report to the Supervisor Model Calibration Team (MCT) in our CXI QA organization. This role is hybrid and will require an in\-office presence, typically 1 day per week, or as the business needs dictate.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Develop deep expertise in DoorDash's QA systems and operational processes to guide meaningful calibration and KPI improvements across multiple lines of business.
* Assist with cross\-functional projects by establishing success metrics, coordinating stakeholders, removing blockers, and clearly communicating progress toward goals.
* Conduct deep dives \& root cause analyses (RCAs) on failure patterns, reversals, and edge cases to uncover inaccuracy trends/drivers.
* Create data models and dashboards to track calibration metrics, auditor accuracy, and sentiment/resolution trends.
* Partner with the Performance Excellence team and Support Operations stakeholders to translate calibration insights into QA strategy improvements.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* You bring 4\+ years in support operations, QA, trust \& safety, or a similar customer\-facing analytical role.
* You can communicate with customers, cross\-functional partners, and senior leaders effectively.
* You enjoy the opportunity to think outside of the box. You can translate goals and blockers into relevant plans for the department.
* Produce recommendations and use data analysis and hypothesis testing to validate your findings.
* You're passionate about identifying opportunities through operating at the lowest level of detail and using a first\-principles approach to problem\-solving.
* You're proficient in Microsoft and/or Google Suite.
* You have experience working with Conversational Intelligence, GPT\-based tools, or QA signal models.

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  

**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.  



How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.  



At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.  



Come break through with us.

  

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry\-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical\-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical\-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

**Role Purpose**



The Classification Lead plays a critical role in coordinating and administering Corning’s global trade compliance product classifications. This includes ensuring full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and policies for HTS (Harmonized Tariff System Classification) and ECCN (Export Control Classification Number) as defined by the Trade Compliance COE.



The role requires collaboration with project Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)—including business engineers—to gather the technical information required for accurate product classification. This position ensures the accuracy, consistency, and compliance of tariff classification processes across all import/export operations, supporting audit readiness and providing strategic guidance to cross‑functional teams in both Mexico and the United States.

  


**Key Responsibilities**

  



Product Classification \& Compliance


* Execute HTS and ECCN classifications using technical and relevant data to determine accurate product classification and/or licensing requirements.
* Perform daily spot checks in SAP/ERP vs. PRISMA/GTS to ensure tariff codes and descriptions are correctly applied prior to customs transmission.
* Manage the technical information required to determine proper product classifications.
* Ensure full compliance with Mexican Customs Law, IMMEX, and U.S. import/export regulations.
* Maintain audit‑ready documentation and proactively identify compliance risks.
* Monitor regulatory changes and update internal classification guidelines accordingly.
* Analyze export control screening results and resolve flagged items.

  



Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Operational Support


* Lead quick IT and Operations huddles when discrepancies or system errors arise, implementing immediate corrective actions to prevent shipment delays.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Engineering, Finance, Purchasing, Logistics, Customs, IT, and Legal to align classification practices.
* Validate classification decisions against purchase orders, invoices, and shipment documentation.
* Partner with teams in other countries to validate critical trade compliance data elements.

  



Leadership \& Team Management


* Supervise, guide, and mentor classification analysts and auditors.
* Assign work, monitor performance, and ensure timely completion of classification reviews.
* Develop and implement classification procedures, checklists, and training programs.
* Provide executive‑level reporting and summaries on classification accuracy, risks, and corrective actions.

  


**Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, International Trade, Customs, Logistics, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in tariff classification, customs compliance, or trade operations.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. and Mexican Customs Law, IMMEX, and U.S. import/export controls.
* Proven leadership experience in compliance or audit teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.
* Advanced skills in Excel, dashboards, database management, and compliance tracking tools.
* Experience with Global Trade Management Systems (GTS E4H, PRISMA, or similar).
* Strong organizational, time‑management, and prioritization skills.

  


**Competencies**


* Detail‑oriented with strong analytical capability.
* Ability to translate regulatory requirements into actionable processes.
* Proactive educator and mentor, promoting compliance awareness across teams.
* Demonstrated leadership and ability to influence cross‑functional groups.

Junior Technical Project Manager
Advisors \& Consulting Services  

The Services area within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value\-added services and leverage expertise, data\-driven insights, and execution. Our Advisors \& Consulting Services team combines traditional management consulting with Mastercard’s rich data assets, proprietary platforms, and technologies to provide clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Our teams work with a diverse global customer base across industries, from banking and payments to retail and restaurants.  

  

The Advisors \& Consulting Services group has five specializations: Strategy \& Transformation, Performance Analytics, Business Experimentation, Marketing, and Program Management. Our Program Management consultants lead clients through business transformations by implementing strategically important Mastercard assets and services to bring value and drive growth. They serve as the Center of Engagement across all stakeholders within Mastercard and the client’s organization.  

  

Positions for different specializations and levels are available in separate job postings. Please review our consulting specializations to learn more about all opportunities and apply for the position that is best suited to your background and experience: https://careers.mastercard.com/us/en/consulting\-specializations\-at\-mastercard
  

  

Role \& Responsibilities  

You will manage defined workstreams or small projects, often embedded within software development or product teams. You will work hands‑on with engineers, testers, and product owners to support agile delivery, track progress, manage risks, and ensure outcomes align with client objectives. It is expected that you will be handling complex analyses and preparing communications to report back to clients and internal leadership. You will develop practical recommendations, contribute to team discussions on implications of analyses, and work alongside the client’s staff on each project, assisting with implementation tasks.  

Client Impact  

* Provide input on multiple small and large high\-value projects across a range of industries and problem statements
* Contribute proven, accredited change skills, domain experience, and delivery methodology to help clients drive measurable value
* Collaborate with Mastercard team to understand clients’ needs, challenges, agenda, and risks
* Develop working relationships with client analysts/managers, and act as trusted and reliable partner
* Identify resources and assign responsibilities, track, and forecast effort and report on expense vs. earned value


Team Collaboration \& Culture

* Lead internal and client meetings with strong communication skills
* Contribute to the firm's intellectual capital and be a strong brand ambassador for Mastercard and Data \& Services
* Receive mentorship from consulting leaders for professional growth and development

* Undergraduate degree
* Ability to communicate effectively in English and the local office language (if applicable)
* Exposure to financial institutions or consultancy firms
* \+2 years of work experience managing IT/software development projects
* Familiarity with agile methods such as Scrum or Kanban
* Ability to oversee projects involving cross\-functional teams
* Experience working with clients or internal stakeholders
* Excellent communication and leadership skills
* Problem\-solving oriented and decision\-making abilities
* Ability to perform multiple tasks with multiple clients in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment

**About Topsort**

At Topsort, we believe in the mission of democratizing the secret technologies of the walled gardens and creating a privacy\-first, cookie\-free world of clean advertising with modern tech, friendly products, and AI. =====================================



Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. It's a sports team that's hyper\-focused on winning — collaborative internally, competitive externally. We thrive on working in the open, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. No endless meetings here — if it can be done today, we get it done today.


**What Is This Role Like?**
===========================



We're looking for a **Customer Support Manager / CS Analyst** to join our Customer Success team in Boston office or LATAM region. This is a hybrid role that sits at the intersection of customer success and data\-driven analysis — not a sales role, but one that requires strong customer\-facing skills and genuine curiosity about how things work.



You'll be the go\-to person for our customers when they run into issues, questions, or need guidance — and you'll also dig into the data to understand patterns, surface insights, and help the team continuously improve. Think: part support champion, part analyst.


**What You'll Do**

* Support customer onboarding by helping configure workflows, validate data, and ensure customers have what they need to get up and running.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers when surfacing findings, flagging issues, or walking them through process changes.
* Help identify at\-risk accounts through data signals and collaborate with the CS team to take proactive action.


**Analysis \& Reporting**


* Analyze support ticket trends, response times, resolution rates, and customer feedback to identify recurring issues and root causes.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports that give the CS team visibility into support health and customer satisfaction.
* Track and maintain SLA metrics; flag breaches and recommend process improvements.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals to produce regular reports for internal stakeholders.

Requisitos Generales


Requisitos exigidos para ingresar a la Administración Pública señalados en el artículo 12 de la Ley Nº 18\.834 sobre Estatuto Administrativo:

  

  

a) Ser ciudadano o extranjero poseedor de un permiso de residencia.
  

b) Haber cumplido con la Ley de reclutamiento y movilización, cuando fuere procedente.
  

c) Tener salud compatible con el desempeño del cargo.
  

d) Haber aprobado la educación básica y poseer el nivel educacional o título profesional o técnico que por la naturaleza del empleo exija la ley. Para aquellos cargos regidos por esta ley en los que se exija tener licencia de educación media, se entenderá que cumplen dicho requisito las personas con discapacidad mayores de 18 años que acrediten haber completado sus estudios en la modalidad de educación especial. Todo lo anterior, de conformidad con lo dispuesto en el decreto Nº 83, de 2015, del Ministerio de Educación, que aprueba criterios y orientaciones de adecuación curricular para estudiantes con necesidades educativas especiales de educación parvularia y educación básica o la normativa que lo reemplace.
  

e) No haber cesado en un cargo público como consecuencia de haber obtenido una calificación deficiente, o por medida disciplinaria, salvo que hayan transcurrido más de cinco años desde la fecha de expiración de funciones. Con todo, conforme lo establecido en el artículo 121 de este Estatuto, no será necesario el cumplimiento de dicho plazo cuando así lo determine el respectivo fiscal.
  

f) No estar inhabilitado para el ejercicio de funciones o cargos públicos, ni hallarse condenado por delito que tenga asignada pena de crimen o simple delito. Sin perjuicio de lo anterior, tratándose del acceso a cargos de auxiliares y administrativos, no será impedimento para el ingreso encontrarse condenado por ilícito que tenga asignada pena de simple delito, siempre que no sea de aquellos contemplados en el Título V, Libro II, del Código Penal.(Cambio vigente desde el 15\.10\.2013, según Ley 20\.702\).
No estar afecto a las inhabilidades establecidas en el artículo 54 de la ley Nº 18\.575 Ley Orgánica Constitucional de Bases Generales de la Administración del Estado:

  

  

a) Tener vigentes o suscribir, por sí o por terceros, contratos o cauciones ascendientes a 200 UTM o más, con el Servicio.
  

b) Tener litigios pendientes con el Servicio, a menos que se refieran al ejercicio de derechos propios, de su cónyuge, hijos, adoptados o parientes hasta el tercer grado de consanguinidad y segundo de afinidad inclusive.
  

c) Ser director, administrador, representante y socio titular del 10% o más de los derechos de cualquier clase de sociedad, cuando ésta tenga contratos o cauciones vigentes ascendientes a 200 UTM o más, o litigios pendientes con el Servicio.
  

d) Ser cónyuge, hijo, adoptado o pariente hasta el tercer grado de consanguinidad o segundo por afinidad inclusive de las autoridades y de los funcionarios directivos del Servicio hasta el nivel de Jefe de Departamento inclusive.
  

e) Desarrollar actividades particulares en los mismos horarios de labores dentro del Servicio, o que interfieran con su desempeño funcionario, salvo actividades de tipo docente, con un máximo de 12 horas semanales.
  

f) Hallarse condenado/a por crimen o simple delito.

* Negociar condiciones económicas básicas en procesos de venta de activos dados de baja o adquisiciones recurrentes.


* Asumir temporalmente procesos de compra de distintas categorías en caso de reemplazos, vacaciones o contingencias del equipo.


* Apoyar análisis comparativos y procesos de mayor complejidad liderados por Analistas o Ingenieros de Compras.

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. * Proactive leader, team player, and natural problem\-solver who thrives in "exploring" new ways to do things.

\- Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters \- refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
* Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!


* dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!



**Flexibility in how you work:** We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.

description:

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando\-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

  



Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

  



A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

  


**Missão do Cargo**



Gerenciar a energia (elétron e molécula) dos clientes da consultoria da Engie Soluções, o que envolve a identificação e exploração das melhores oportunidades relacionadas ao uso de energéticos dentro do limite regulatório, contratual e financeiro. Além disso, o cargo será responsável por conduzir as operações e processos necessários, sempre com foco na eficiência e na satisfação do cliente

  


**Principais Atividades**

  



Ênfase Portfólio:



* Auxiliar as etapas de atendimento ao cliente no mercado livre, follow\-up das solicitações e gestão de terceiros. Dar suporte na elaboração do controle de prazos de entregas de atividades e projetos, garantindo o cumprimento de datas combinadas.

* Elaborar relatórios, realizar validação de dados e atividades operacionais relacionadas ao setor de energia.
  



Ênfase Operações CCEE:

* Apoiar na realização de reuniões, fóruns e outras formas de comunicação com a gestão de portfólio, alinhando os conhecimentos e requisitos necessários para a realização das operações exigidas pela CCEE.
  



Ênfase Setor Elétrico e Regulação:



* Realizar análises e estudos regulatórios e de movimentos do setor elétrico, com o objetivo de construir pareceres consultivos para os clientes da consultoria.


* Estudar e apoiar as análises de indicadores que influenciam nos custos de energia elétrica, sejam eles preços modelados matematicamente, tarifas ou encargos setoriais. Além disso, realizar previsões, estimativas e justificativas para suas variações.

Ênfase Mercado de Energia:

* Apoio na análise dos aspectos comerciais e regulatórios das propostas e minutas de compra ou venda de energia.
  



Ênfase Relatórios e Produtos:



* Apoiar a organização e preparação de todos os processos, requisitos, bases e outras ferramentas necessárias para a entrega de todos os relatórios e produtos disponibilizados no escopo da consultoria, sejam eles de escopo estratégico, de mercado ou com informações de consumo e performance dos clientes.

Voce gosta de transformar desafios logisticos em solucoes praticas e eficientes? Entao venha fazer parte da nossa equipe! Estamos em busca de um(a) ANALISTA DE LOGISTICA JUNIOR para atuar diretamente no acompanhamento das operacoes de transporte da frota propria, terceiros e agregados. Essa pessoa sera responsavel por atividades como controle de viagens, atualizacao de sistemas, emissao de documentos de transporte, comunicacao com motoristas e agendamento de cargas. A funcao e fundamental para fortalecer a integracao entre areas, otimizar o desempenho logistico e garantir decisoes operacionais mais ageis e alinhadas a estrategia da companhia. Transmitir aos motoristas todas as informacoes necessarias, horarios, rotas, locais de carga e descarga, e procedimentos internos conforme a programacao do dia, com o objetivo de controlar a disponibilidade de cargas e direcionar a melhor alocacao da frota. Prestar suporte a equipe de logistica na abertura de processos de avarias e adernamentos, assim como apoiar a comunicacao entre areas internas, como financeiro, recursos humanos e manutencao. No **Brasil**, estamos desde 1970, com mais de **5\.000 colaboradores** e atuação em diversos segmentos: motocicletas, WaveRunners e motores de popa, além de serviços financeiros (Banco, Consórcio e Corretora de Seguros) e logística (Yamalog). Nossa rede inclui cerca de 500 concessionárias e pontos de venda autorizados em todo o território nacional.

  

Na Yamaha, acreditamos que a verdadeira potência vem das pessoas. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Cada pessoa é respeitada por sua singularidade\- gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica. Nossa política global de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão tem como princípio o “RESPEITO.” com ponto final \- que simboliza que o respeito deve ser praticado sem exceções, reconhecendo e valorizando todas as diferenças humanas.

  

Se você é movido(a) por desafios e quer transformar paixão em movimento, venha fazer parte da Yamaha e **gerar Kando** às pessoas todos os dias.

O(a) Analista de Gestão de Pessoas e Cultura Jr atua como apoio estratégico na execução das ações de comunicação interna, engajamento, cultura organizacional e experiência do colaborador, garantindo o alinhamento entre colaboradores, liderança e os valores da Yamaha.

* Comunicados institucionais
* Murais, TVs corporativas e intranet
* E\-mails internos e campanhas informativas
* Apoiar a divulgação de mensagens estratégicas da liderança, campanhas internas e ações corporativas.
* Garantir padronização de linguagem, identidade institucional e tom adequado aos diferentes públicos internos (produção, administrativo, liderança).
* Apoiar ações voltadas ao fortalecimento da cultura organizacional, valores e princípios da Yamaha.
* Colaborar na organização de campanhas de engajamento, datas comemorativas, eventos internos e ações de reconhecimento.

title: Analista Jr de Logística (Insumos)
description:
Estamos com diversas vagas de Analista Júnior em Logística e buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em nossa torre de **Insumos**.

  

Não exigimos experiência direta em **Insumos**, desde que apresente capacidade técnica e perfil para navegar de forma híbrida entre planejamento (S\&OP, MRP, gestão de demanda e timeline) e execução tática (abastecimento, call off, compras operacionais, controle de estoque e transporte). O essencial é ter um perfil analítico e bagagem e maturidade para compreender o plano, priorizar com clareza e converter análises em resultados.

  

A logística de Insumos da Ambev sustenta gigantescas cadeias de operações no mundo das maiores e mais valiosas marcas de bebidas, especialmente cervejas. São mais de 25 fábricas que dependem de um fluxo contínuo de abastecimento, transporte e controle de estoque. Manter tudo rodando com eficiência exige visão sistêmica, adaptação, agilidade e decisões com inteligência de dados.

  

O perfil ideal para ocupar esta cadeira é alguém que genuinamente **curioso**, que **aprenda rápido**, que **assuma responsabilidades com autonomia** e **gere valor,** conectando **visão sistêmica** com **execução ágil**. Também será sempre convidado a ir além: gradativamente melhorar processos, propor mudanças, automatizar rotinas, explorar tecnologias, usar dados com profundidade e elevar o nível da torre para que seja cada vez mais estratégica e eficiente.

  

A cadeira tem visibilidade real, lidando diretamente com altas lideranças, e espaço para crescimento para quem entrega com consistência e se torna referência. Ou seja, é uma função que precisa de alguém de boa execução técnica e operacional para garantir o hoje, mas que também consiga pensar no futuro, questionando, otimizando e transformando, com ambições de liderar.

  

Se você tem um perfil com ambição, tem perfil de dono, curiosidade e profundidade, terá condições de ganhar protagonismo nesta cadeira e evoluir junto com a área.

 **Local**: Jaguariúna, SP no CSC da Ambev. Temos fretado na região (até 40km).

**Modalidade**: Híbrido 3x2 atualmente, com possibilidade futura de 100% presencial.

 **Responsabilidades e atribuições**  

A torre de Insumos é responsável por garantir que nossas fábricas tenham tudo o que precisam para produzir no tempo certo, com eficiência e previsibilidade. É uma área crítica, que exige decisões rápidas, visão de processo e forte conexão entre dados, operação e estratégia. É um equilíbrio entre executar com profundidade e ser capaz de gradativamente evoluir a área.

* Garantir o abastecimento de insumos às fábricas, equilibrando demanda, estoque, lead time e nível de serviço.
* Utilizar SAP/MRP, Portal de Insumos e S\&OP para planejar necessidades e transformar análise em ação.
* Executar o call\-off e acompanhar entregas, resolvendo desvios com agilidade.
* Monitorar indicadores críticos e antecipar riscos de ruptura, excesso ou obsolescência.
* Conectar áreas\-chave (fábricas, supply, compras, transporte, planejamento) para alinhar decisões e garantir fluidez operacional.
* Participar de fóruns de planejamento e rotinas operacionais, ajustando planos conforme a realidade do dia a dia.
* Propor melhorias, automatizar rotinas e usar dados para aumentar eficiência e reduzir custos.
* Garantir a execução do cronograma de projetos de mudança de insumos

  

**Requisitos e qualificações**  

* Ensino superior ou tecnólogo completo: Formação em Administração, Engenharias, Logística ou áreas correlatas (valorizamos mais a profundidade prática e perfil do que o nome do curso).
* Experiência compatível em logística para navegar bem entre planejamento de materiais, supply chain, S\&OP, abastecimento, estoque, compras operacionais ou transporte, com maturidade para entender o todo e entregar com consistência.
* Excel no mínimo intermediário.
* Ser *data driven*, com capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados. Não é obrigatório, mas Power BI, SQL, Python, Gen AI e outras ferramentas para análise de dados e automatização sempre agregarão.
* Perfil de dono, curiosidade e iniciativa, atuando com melhoria contínua, resolução de problemas e proposta de soluções além da execução operacional.
* Inglês ou Espanhol não são obrigatórios, mas dado nossas operações globais, são cada dia mais necessários.

  

**Informações adicionais**  

Na Ambev, oferecemos um pacote completo de benefícios pensado para você e também para seus dependentes. Confira o que você encontra por aqui:

**About the Role**

We are seeking a results\-driven Business Analyst to support the development and deployment of workflow automation technologies tailored to the needs of our top\-tier investment banking clients. We are a global software and professional services company for the financial industry, with offices in the UK, USA, Germany, Brazil, Hong Kong and Indonesia. For layman, a structured product is a financial investment (not unlike a savings account) where the return to the investor depends on the performance of an underlying asset (e.g., a stock or an index). While structured products tend to offer a higher return than a savings account, they also tend to come with a higher risk. Therefore, the issuance (i.e., the creation) of a structured product and its offering to investors is highly regulated. We
  

offer banks automation solutions to make that issuance process simpler. The core of our automation solution is a document automation tool that facilitates the creation of fact sheets, term sheets and similar documents which describe the products. We are looking to hire developers and financial experts to work with this core automation solution.

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
Podean is the leading global marketplace marketing agency. We work with progressive brands across the globe to unlock potential on Amazon and other marketplaces. Our services span eCommerce strategy, content creation and optimization, media management, retail operations, data and analytics, consulting, and social commerce. Recent award wins include Digiday's Best Employer for Remote Employees and Amazon's Global Expansion Partner Award.


We are seeking a **Senior Account Manager** to partner with clients and the broader Podean team to develop and execute Amazon and marketplace strategies and unlock incremental brand growth.. Client servicing, strategy, program delivery, project management, and analysis will all be key functions in this role with the expectation that the account manager is well\-versed in all aspects of eCommerce strategy including media, creative, and retail solutions.


**What You'll Do**


* Own client relationships end\-to\-end \- serve as the primary contact for senior stakeholders (including C\-suite), lead all meetings and presentations, manage expectations, and build lasting trust.
* Drive marketplace strategy \- develop annual brand strategies, marketing and promotional plans, and supply chain recommendations. Identify new workstreams and upsell opportunities proactively.
* Execute and manage cross\-functional delivery \- coordinate with media, retail, creative, and sales teams to ensure projects are delivered on time and to a high standard. Own reporting, recaps, and action items.
* Stay ahead of the platform \- monitor Amazon and marketplace updates, communicate relevant changes to clients, and translate new opportunities into actionable recommendations.
* Contribute to agency growth \- support new business pitches, develop internal best practices and SOPs, contribute to agency thought leadership, and run onboarding/training sessions as needed.


**What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years in eCommerce, digital media, or marketplace marketing \- with hands\-on Amazon expertise across advertising, retail fundamentals, and platform tools/programs.
* Experience across additional global marketplaces and ad platforms, including Mercado Livre, Shopee, Shein, AliExpress, and tools such as VTEX Ads and Topsort.
* Experience in an agency environment, ideally marketplace or eCommerce\-focused, with exposure to managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Proven ability to manage senior client relationships, align on business goals, and translate strategy into measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communicator across all levels \- you can present to a CMO and coach a junior analyst in the same afternoon.
* Advanced or fluent English, with the ability to hold conversations with international teams.
* Highly organized, commercially sharp, and comfortable with ambiguity. You own your work and don't need to be chased.
* Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable in data\-driven environments.


**Why Join Podean?**


Podean is proud to be recognized as one of *Digiday's Best Employers for Remote Employees*. We combine the energy of a fast\-growing global agency with the balance and trust of a remote\-first culture.


You'll join a globally connected, award\-winning team that values:


* **Competitive compensation** aligned to experience and market benchmarks
* **Remote\-first flexibility** \- work from anywhere, with trust and autonomy
* **Global collaboration** \- working with experts across regions and time zones
* **Career growth and development** \- opportunities to evolve as we scale
* **5\-Year Sabbatical** \+ **Travel Stipend** \- After your 5\-year anniversary, take a fully paid month\-long sabbatical, plus a travel reimbursement to make your experience restorative and inspiring
* **Positive\-energy culture** \- grounded in respect, inclusion, and accountability
* **Meaningful impact** helping some of the world's most progressive brands grow

title: Community Engagement Analyst - Analista de Impacto Social, EDSP Growth & Excellence
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


O Analista de Impacto Social apoia a execução e gestão operacional de programas de investimento comunitário dentro da Amazon Logistics (AMZL) no Brasil. Esta função está inserida na equipe de Growth \& Excellence sob o programa EDSP e é responsável pelo rastreamento de Ordens de Compra (PO), documentação de prestação de contas financeira, gestão de cronogramas, análise de dados, gestão de relacionamento com parceiros e presença em campo em iniciativas comunitárias. O analista atua como ponto de contato operacional entre a Amazon e parceiros comunitários, garantindo conformidade, transparência e impacto social mensurável.  

  

\-  

  

The Community Engagement Analyst supports the execution and operational management of community investment programs within Amazon Logistics (AMZL) in Brazil. This role sits within the Growth \& Excellence team under the EDSP program and is responsible for Purchase Order (PO) tracking, financial accountability documentation, timeline management, data analysis, partner relationship management, and field presence at community initiatives. The analyst serves as the operational point of contact between Amazon and community partners, ensuring compliance, transparency, and measurable social impact.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Preparar, submeter e rastrear Ordens de Compra (POs) através da plataforma de doações da Amazon, gerenciando o ciclo completo de PO desde a submissão até a prestação de contas
* Consolidar e revisar documentação mensal de prestação de contas financeira, incluindo relatórios de despesas, notas fiscais, evidências e listas de beneficiários
* Construir e manter dashboards rastreando KPIs de impacto comunitário e preparar relatórios mensais de desempenho para stakeholders internos
* Monitorar marcos de projetos, prazos e SLAs em todas as iniciativas ativas; coordenar reuniões mensais com parceiros e documentar atas de reunião
* Atuar como ponto de contato operacional entre a Amazon e parceiros comunitários, coordenando entregas, cronogramas e documentação
* Apoiar equipes jurídicas, fiscais e de compliance com documentação contratual e requisitos regulatórios para processos de doação
* Participar presencialmente de eventos comunitários e iniciativas lideradas por parceiros, documentando atividades e coletando dados de impacto qualitativos e quantitativos
* Apoiar futuros programas de logística comunitária mapeando potenciais parceiros sem fins lucrativos e preparando para expansão do programa


\-  

* Prepare, submit, and track Purchase Orders (POs) through Amazon's donation platform, managing the full PO lifecycle from submission to accountability

  

* Consolidate and review monthly financial accountability documentation, including expense reports, invoices, evidence, and beneficiary lists

  

* Build and maintain dashboards tracking community impact KPIs and prepare monthly performance reports for internal stakeholders

  

* Monitor project milestones, deadlines, and SLAs across all active initiatives; coordinate monthly partner meetings and document meeting minutes

  

* Serve as the operational point of contact between Amazon and community partners, coordinating deliverables, timelines, and documentation

  

* Support legal, tax, and compliance teams with contractual documentation and regulatory requirements for donation processes

  

* Attend community events and partner\-led initiatives in person, documenting activities and collecting qualitative and quantitative impact data

  

* Support future community logistics programs by mapping potential nonprofit partners and preparing for program expansion

  

A day in the life  

Esta função está na interseção entre gestão de programas, engajamento comunitário e operações financeiras dentro da Amazon Logistics (AMZL) Brasil. Em um dia típico, você pode começar atualizando o controle de Ordens de Compra e revisando documentos de prestação de contas recebidos de nosso parceiro comunitário, depois participar de uma reunião de coordenação para alinhar os próximos marcos da iniciativa. À tarde, você pode estar preparando um relatório mensal de impacto com KPIs para stakeholders internos ou coordenando com nossas equipes de TAX e Jurídico sobre documentação de compliance. Em alguns dias, você estará em campo — participando de eventos comunitários, documentando atividades e coletando dados de impacto diretamente dos beneficiários. Seus stakeholders internos incluem liderança AMZL, equipe de Growth \& Excellence, equipes de TAX, Jurídico, Finanças e PR. Seus clientes externos são os parceiros comunitários e as comunidades que eles atendem. O problema central que você resolve é garantir que os investimentos comunitários da Amazon sejam executados com transparência, conformidade e impacto social mensurável.  

\-  

This role sits at the intersection of program management, community engagement, and financial operations within Amazon Logistics (AMZL) Brazil. On a typical day, you might start by updating the PO tracker and reviewing accountability documents received from our community partner, then join a coordination call to align on upcoming initiative milestones. In the afternoon, you could be preparing a monthly impact report with KPIs for internal stakeholders or coordinating with our TAX and Legal teams on compliance documentation. Some days, you'll be out in the field — attending community events, documenting activities, and collecting impact data directly from beneficiaries. Your internal stakeholders include AMZL leadership, Growth \& Excellence team, TAX, Legal, Finance, and PR teams. Your external customers are the community partners and the communities they serve. The core problem you solve is ensuring that Amazon's community investments are executed with transparency, compliance, and measurable social impact.  

  

About the team  

AMZL (Amazon Logistics), também referida como Last Mile, é o processamento de pacotes em nossos Centros logísticos até seu destino final — nossos clientes. AMZL BR foi lançada em Nov\-20 com a visão de longo prazo de trazer uma experiência de entrega aprimorada com o custo adequado.  

  

Nossa equipe foca em EDSP (Provedores de Serviço de Entrega Externos) e AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics) dentro da estrutura de Growth \& Excellence. EDSP é uma Estação de Entrega operada por terceiros com custo totalmente variável e sem ativos, que usa ferramentas e tecnologia da Amazon para expandir a cobertura de entrega em todo o Brasil.  

  

Como parte de nosso compromisso com as comunidades onde operamos, estamos lançando iniciativas de engajamento comunitário para fortalecer o relacionamento da Amazon com comunidades locais — gerando impacto social real através de parcerias estratégicas com organizações sociais líderes. Esta é uma posição totalmente nova e uma oportunidade única de moldar como a Amazon Logistics se engaja com comunidades em todo o Brasil.  

\-  

AMZL (Amazon Logistics), also referred to as the Last Mile, is the movement of packages from our Fulfillment Centers or Sort Centers to their final destination — our customers. AMZL BR launched in Nov\-20 with the long\-term vision of bringing an enhanced delivery experience at the right cost.  

  

Our team focuses on EDSP (External Delivery Service Providers) and AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics) within the Growth \& Excellence program. EDSP is an asset\-light, full variable cost third\-party operated Delivery Station which uses Amazon tools and technology to expand delivery coverage across Brazil.  

As part of our commitment to the communities where we operate, we are launching community engagement initiatives to strengthen Amazon's relationship with local communities — driving real social impact through strategic partnerships with leading social organizations. This is a brand\-new position and a unique opportunity to shape how Amazon Logistics engages with communities across Brazil.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience previously in program or project management
* Experience with data analysis and basic Excel skills
* Experience with purchasing or inventory management in e\-commerce or retail
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service
* Experience in oral and written communication
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience creating, improving and executing engagement programs and action plans
* Experience using data visualization tools
* Knowledge of statutory compliance requirements
* Experience in English\-language communication skills, both written and verbal

In the U.S., the company operates state\-specific websites such as NewYorkBets.com, BetCarolina.com and BetArizona.com, helping consumers discover and connect with legal gambling options.



In addition to its marketing operations, Gambling.com Group provides sports data services through consumer subscription platforms like OddsJam and RotoWire, along with B2B services through OpticOdds. These offerings deliver real\-time data, actionable insights and technology\-driven tools to both consumers and enterprise partners. As the first and only online gambling affiliate publicly traded in the U.S., Gambling.com Group has earned recognition as a leader in its field – most recently winning Affiliate of the Year and Sports Affiliate of the Year at the 2025 EGR Operator Awards.



Gambling.com Group embraces a majority remote\-first hybrid work model, offering employees the flexibility to work remotely while being part of a global team. For some roles, in\-office presence is required for operational reasons, ensuring seamless collaboration and effectiveness where needed. With flagship offices in Dublin, Charlotte and Malta and satellite offices in Madison, Serbia and Costa Rica, we operate on a 'think local, act global' mindset.



The Senior Systems Analyst owns the data and systems foundation of FP\&A, ensuring that high\-quality, well\-structured and forward\-looking datasets are available to support analysis, business partnering and decision\-making across the Group.



The role acts as the central hub for FP\&A data, integrating inputs from operational systems and teams and enabling insight without placing data\-management burden on analysts or business partners.



The role also plays a key part in exploring how emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI) and advanced analytics, can be applied responsibly within FP\&A to enhance insight, efficiency and decision support. This includes identifying opportunities to use AI\-enabled tools to automate repetitive processes, surface trends, and support more forward\-looking analysis, while ensuring appropriate governance and data quality standards are maintained.



Responsibilities:



The Senior Systems Analyst is responsible for owning and developing the data and systems ecosystem that underpins FP\&A reporting and analysis across the Group. The role acts as the central point of expertise for FP\&A data, integrations and reporting platforms, enabling the wider finance team to focus on insight, decision support and business partnering.



The role is highly proactive in nature, focused on identifying, integrating and exposing new datasets that enhance financial insight and decision\-making. This includes working closely with teams across the business to understand their data, assess how it can be leveraged, and integrate it into Cube and related analytics platforms in a structured and scalable way.



The Senior Systems Analyst is expected to manage end\-to\-end data processes, from source system integration through to availability in reporting tools, and to continuously challenge and improve how FP\&A data is structured, accessed and used. The role requires a high degree of independence, curiosity and technical capability, with a strong expectation that the role holder brings ideas, solutions and best\-in\-class practices to the table.



Key Accountabilities:


* Act as the focal point for all FP\&A data, systems and integrations across the Finance function
* Own and develop data structures, models and hierarchies within the Group's FP\&A platform
* Proactively identify and integrate new data sources from across the organisation to enhance FP\&A reporting and insight
* Work closely with stakeholders in Finance, HR, Marketing, Product, Operations and Technology to understand data needs and integration opportunities
* Design and manage end\-to\-end data processes, ensuring data flows reliably from source systems into FP\&A tools
* Explore and implement innovative approaches to data integration, automation and modelling, reducing manual intervention and dependency
* Maintain and enhance reporting datasets used by the FP\&A team
* Build and maintain robust documentation covering data models, integrations, processes and controls
* Ensure data is structured to support forward\-looking analysis, trend analysis and scenario modelling
* Actively research and propose best\-in\-class tools, techniques and ways of working relevant to FP\&A systems and data
* Support the effective use of analytics and visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) within FP\&A
* Identify and evaluate opportunities to apply AI and advanced analytics techniques to FP\&A data and reporting, with a focus on improving insight, efficiency and scalability
* Support the use of AI\-enabled tools to automate repetitive data preparation and reporting tasks, reducing manual effort across FP\&A
* Enable more advanced analytical use cases (e.g. trend detection, driver analysis, scenario support) through improved data structures and modelling
* Work with Finance leadership and IT to ensure the responsible and well\-governed use of AI within FP\&A systems and processes
* Collaborate with colleagues to understand evolving requirements and translate these into scalable data solutions


Ways of Working:



The Senior Systems Analyst is expected to operate as a change agent within FP\&A, including:


* Proactively challenging existing data structures, processes and assumptions
* Bringing ideas and proposals for improving data availability, quality and usability
* Reducing reliance on manual processes and individual knowledge
* Encouraging consistent, standardised and well\-governed data practices
* Staying informed on emerging tools, platforms and best practices in systems and analytics
* Actively explores emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled analytics and automation tools, to continuously improve FP\&A systems, insight and ways of working

**Please note this is a fixed\-term position with an anticipated end date of January 31, 2027\.**

**THE TEAM**

The Ticketmaster HR Shared Services team is at the core of all employee activities across the organization. Our team focuses on delivering a consistent, efficient, and scalable HR experience for employees around the world. We work to standardize processes, improve service delivery, and leverage technology to support the entire employee lifecycle.


Within HR Shared Services, the HR Operations team manages administrative and transactional HR processes, drives operational improvements, and supports the implementation of global HR systems and solutions. The team works cross\-functionally with HR, technology, and business partners to improve operational efficiency and deliver a seamless employee experience.


**THE JOB**

As HR continues to centralize and standardize employee services across markets, the HR Operations Implementation Analyst plays a key role in supporting the implementation of global HR processes, systems, and service delivery.


This role partners closely with the HR Operations Implementation Manager to support the rollout of standardized HR processes, global services, and HR technology solutions. The Analyst will focus on process documentation, project coordination, system implementation support, and operational improvements that enhance employee experience and service efficiency.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving operational challenges, working with technology\-enabled solutions, and helping build scalable HR processes that support employees across multiple markets.


**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

*Global Process Standardization \& Documentation*

* Support the standardization and documentation of HR operational processes across markets to enable a consistent global HR service delivery approach.
* Assist with process mapping, workflow documentation, and the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and operational playbooks.
* Partner with HR stakeholders to gather requirements and document current and future\-state HR processes.
* Help identify opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce manual processes, and improve operational efficiency.

*HR Technology \& System Implementation*

* Support the implementation and rollout of Salesforce as the global HR case management and ticketing platform.
* Assist with system configuration testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and documentation of system functionality.
* Help implement HR technologies and vendor platforms that support employee lifecycle processes such as background checks, work authorization verification, and other operational tools.
* Maintain system documentation, user guides, and knowledge articles to support HR Operations teams.

*Project Coordination \& Operational Support*

* Support global HR Operations transformation projects by coordinating project activities, tracking deliverables, and supporting implementation timelines.
* Assist in gathering business requirements and translating operational needs into system or process enhancements.
* Track project progress, risks, and action items while supporting cross\-functional collaboration between HR, IT, and other teams.

*AI \& Digital HR Enablement*

* Support the rollout of AI\-enabled HR support tools and automation initiatives within HR Operations.
* Help develop operational documentation, training materials, and guidance to support HR team adoption of new technologies.
* Assist in identifying opportunities where automation or digital tools can improve HR service delivery.

*Operational Data \& Continuous Improvement*

* Support the analysis of HR operational metrics to identify service trends and opportunities for improvement.
* Assist with monitoring service delivery performance, ticketing metrics, and operational KPIs.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing the employee experience and operational efficiency.

**WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)**

*HR Operations \& Shared Services*

* At least 3 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HR Systems, or HR project support.
* Basic understanding of HR service delivery models, case management systems, and HR lifecycle processes.

*Process Documentation \& Improvement*

* Experience documenting business processes, workflows, and standard operating procedures.
* Familiarity with process mapping tools and continuous improvement methodologies is preferred.

*HR Technology \& Systems*

* Experience supporting HR technology platforms such as:
	+ HRIS systems (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM)
	+ Case management or ticketing systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk)
	+ Knowledge management platforms
* Experience supporting technology implementations, testing, or system rollouts is a plus.

*Project Coordination \& Implementation Support*

* Experience supporting cross\-functional projects or operational initiatives.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, timelines, and project deliverables in a fast\-paced environment.

*Data Analysis \& Reporting*

* Ability to analyze operational data and support reporting related to service delivery performance and operational metrics *.*

**YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)**

* **Problem Solver:** You enjoy identifying operational challenges and working collaboratively to find scalable and efficient solutions.
* **Detail\-Oriented:** You are highly organized and able to document processes, track project details, and ensure accuracy in operational work.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** You work well with cross\-functional teams and build strong relationships with HR, technology, and operational partners.
* **Curious \& Process\-Minded:** You have a natural curiosity about how processes work and are motivated to improve systems and workflows.
* **Adaptable:** You are comfortable working in an evolving environment and supporting transformation initiatives across multiple markets.
* **Strong Communicator:** You can clearly communicate process changes, documentation, and project updates to a variety of stakeholders.
